name: c-make
title: GNU Make
summary: The same integration with no helpers -- the dsdlc command line and GNU Make: a query for the file lists, a stamp standing in for a multiple-output rule, and depfiles for the transitive dependencies.
notes: Portable back to GNU Make 3.81, which is what macOS still ships, so a stamp file stands in for 4.3's grouped targets (`&:`). Two independent sets of depfiles are included: dsdlc's `-MD`, which records the definitions behind each generated file, and the C compiler's `-MMD`, which records the headers behind each object.

requires.reason: compiles the generated C and the round-trip program
